purpose: Production candidate: PV+TOU rule (DefaultUpper + DefaultLower) overlaid with C6 forecast-aware safety shield. 30-day benchmark: -14.76% J vs grid_only @ 998kWh, beats every PI-SAC variant we trained (v1 synthetic, v2 real-data, v3 forecast-aware obs).

data.evaluation_dates: 2022-05-24 ~ 2022-06-22 (30 days, paired delta vs v1/v2/v3 PI-SAC variants)

upper_model.description: DefaultUpperPlanner: zero share-plan (no inter-station energy transfer)

lower_models.description: DefaultLowerAgent: zero action (no ESS move), then overridden by C6 safety shield

deployment_notes.ev_scale_calibration: If the upstream payload (DEFAULT_EV_SAC_PAYLOAD_PATH) is aggregated to jeju_total (peak ~3733 kWh/hour), include ev_scale ≈ 0.43 in the dispatch request body so per-station peak settles in the shield-effective range (~peak_limit + 100 kWh = ~550 kWh per station).
deployment_notes.spec_mismatch_warning: Station spec (ess_capacity_kwh=998, peak_limit_kwh=450) is sized for a single charging hub. Payload at ev_scale=1.0 represents aggregate jeju demand and exceeds spec by ~3x; shield discharges saturate at 99.8 kWh and provide minimal relief.

api_input_schema.description: Same as v1: server queries day_data by date from DB.

api_output_schema.description: Same as v1 + shield activation flag in per-row metadata (future enhancement).
